summary: Ellington Credit Company, a NYSE-listed mortgage REIT (EARN; 8.50% notes ELLA due 2031), filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 7, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Trustees declared a monthly common distribution of $0.08 per share. The distribution is payable November 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 30, 2026. The filing includes the related press release as Exhibit 99.1 and standard forward-looking-statement language. This is a routine ordinary-course dividend declaration, not a special situation, with no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics requiring risk-arb analysis.
